ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 15% low-intensity (black) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) border along the trailing edge and lateral tips. Large contiguous high-intensity (white) central field. Symmetrical yellowish-brown low-contrast pigmentation patches concentrated near the basal center and extending towards the mid-lobes. Discrete dark circular pixel clusters located in the upper-left and lower-center regions of the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 92 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approx 1:2 within its local bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 5 to 20 pixels. The pattern is irregular, with more pronounced, jagged peaks located at the distal lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a symmetrical concave curve transitioning into convex curves at the lateral tips relative to the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single prominent dark circular cluster on the mid-left lobe. Smaller, less defined dark clusters detected near the basal notch and lower-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-directional greyish linear pixel disruptions detected on the high-intensity field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular indentation and fragmentation on the leftmost distal tip, deviating from the standard serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown low-intensity staining localized along the basal margin and lower quadrants of both fluke lobes.
